name: Threads (Meta)
description: Meta's text-based social network; the Threads API supports publishing posts/replies, reading and managing replies, mentions, and insights.
access_notes: Creating a Meta app with the Threads use case is self-serve and free; designated Threads testers can grant permissions immediately for development. To act on ordinary users' accounts, each permission (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, etc.) must pass Meta App Review (screencast, privacy policy, often business verification) and the app must be published/live.
mcp_notes: No official Meta MCP for Threads found on developers.facebook.com, and the docs.composio.dev toolkit catalog contains no Threads toolkit. Searches tried: 'Threads API MCP', Composio catalog page grep for 'threads'.
uncertainty_notes: API is focused on publishing/replies/insights (no ads, no DMs), hence medium breadth. Long-lived tokens last 60 days and must be refreshed; private-profile permissions expire after 90 days.

evidence.note: OAuth 2.0 user access tokens; testers can grant permissions any time, but for non-tester users 'each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published'
Authorization Window flow: authorization code exchanged at graph.threads.com/oauth/access_token for user access tokens with threads_* scopes
Publishing endpoints: create media container then threads_publish for text/image/video/carousel posts
Webhooks for Threads: real-time notifications for replies, mentions, publish and delete topics
Composio toolkit catalog contains no Threads toolkit (checked full catalog listing)
